<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a byproduct of breaking down any workstation that originally required metallic materials. Alternatively, it's also found within the [[Dungeon]] as dropped loot, either from defeating an [[monster#Heavy-Hitters|Iron Maiden]] or by destroying certain objects. While it cannot be bought, sold, or studied, it can be smelted back into an [[Iron ingot]] using any available furnace.
